name: RMM Verus-verified spec-bug benchmark (rel0)

detection.obligation: bug present iff Verus REJECTS the assert
detection.contradiction: bug present iff Verus ACCEPTS `ensures false`

note: rel0 carries 3 of the 5 known bugs: RMI_RTT_INIT_RIPAS was fixed between eac5 and rel0, and RMI_PDEV_STOP does not exist before 1.1. FP obligation items do not discriminate between generators -- see ground_truth_eac5.json.

items.signature: rd: Address, ipa: Address, result: Result<(), RmiStatusCode>, data: Address, top: Address, old_s: S, new_s: S

lets: let old_walk = RttWalk_(old_s, rd, ipa,RMM_RTT_PAGE_LEVEL as int);
let new_walk = RttWalk_(new_s, rd, ipa,RMM_RTT_PAGE_LEVEL as int);
items.label: TP
